text:
alex: PSA: my ferret Pixel apparently thinks ethernet cables are chew toys. intermittent disconnects all morning. pic: (image: pixel-chews-ethernet.jpg) https://photos.example.com/pixel123
maria: omg adorable and catastrophic :heart_eyes: how are you still online?
alex: had to reroute everything under the desk, taped cables into a fortress. also bought a cable sleeve.
tyler: ferrets are portable chaos generators. quick tip: put bitterant spray on cables. worked for my dog.
noah: did you run a quick perf check? curious how much packet loss it caused.
alex: good call. infra-bot, can you run a 1-min ping to staging and post results?
infra-bot: scheduled by alex at 2152001125  1-min ping to staging: avg=24ms, loss=0% (post-chew). earlier probe at 2152001105 shows avg=128ms, loss=12%. full logs in #eng-infra.
zoe: :laughing: PIXEL THE TROLL. also vote: ferret cam in our next "weird setups" show-and-tell? :raised_hands:
maria: yes! cutest interruption category winner for sure.
tyler: agree. i'm bringing my toddler-keyboard-apocalypse photo.
noah: suggestion: quick channel guide on pet-proofing wires. small checklist could save hours.
alex: will do later today. for now, Pixel is on kibble duty and wifi is... grudgingly stable.
zoe: post a before/after cable-fort pic tomorrow and you'll get a virtual cookie.
alex: deal. (also Pixel says sorry but will attend show-and-tell with pride)
